purpose: Five distinct FineVideo sources, single seed, selected past-image appearance utility under prompted view changes; not a state/event/dynamics or retrieval benchmark.

rejections.original_cooking_and_continuous_presente: Local commonly already reveals relevant appearance.
rejections.row16_doorbell: Introductory finished-product footage complicates chronological state claims; not needed for five-source appearance cohort.

limitations: Hand-curated from one cached shard, not a random population sample.
These are independent source files, not proof of statistical independence or universal long-range performance.
No state, event, multi-evidence or video-motion transfer claim.

examples.prompt: The video returns to the nursery manager's seated interview as she continues speaking.

evaluation_attributes_do_not_condition_o: Dark hair in a bun and the same apparent face
Red long sleeves under a black sleeveless pinafore
review.observations: Local contains a laptop and pointing hand, without the returning person. Oracle is a medium interview view; GT is a closer side view.
limitations: The camera return is explicitly requested.
Appearance at a new framing is tested; identity is a visual judgment, not a biometric score.

examples.prompt: The view switches to the same robot model posed on its display turntable, showing its head and upper body.

evaluation_attributes_do_not_condition_o: Angular helmet and small gold face insert
Upper shoulder armor shape and layered head-to-chest design
review.observations: Local shows hands holding the robot torso and legs, with the head outside the top of the frame. Oracle shows the head at close range; GT uses a wider display pose.
limitations: Black body color and much of the chest are already in Local and do not count as recovered evidence.
Head details occupy few pixels in the wider GT.
The source target is nearly static for much of this window; motion cannot be a primary success test here.

examples.prompt: The view returns to the student standing at the teacher's desk as she listens and responds.

evaluation_attributes_do_not_condition_o: Front curls and light shirt under the open hoodie
review.observations: Local faces the teacher and shows only part of the student from behind/right. Oracle and early GT face the student; the GT student turns away near the end.
limitations: Maroon hoodie and some rear hair are already visible in Local and do not establish retrieval benefit.
Oracle and GT are similar reverse-angle shots with only a 14.58 second gap from the selected interval end.
The prompt specifies the role and shot direction, not the clothing or hair.
Exact GT turn timing is not requested; note pose copying separately.

examples.prompt: The camera transitions outside to the camper van from the tour as it slowly drives across the driveway.

evaluation_attributes_do_not_condition_o: Cream-white boxy body with a brown side stripe
Black front grille with round headlights and the same window layout
review.observations: Local shows the driving interior. The target starts immediately before an approximately one-second cross-dissolve to the van exterior. Oracle shows the parked van from a closer, different location.
limitations: The broad camper-van category is in the prompt and is not a recovered attribute.
Target includes a cross-dissolve and another parked van in the background.
Some generic vehicle identity may be inferred from the steering wheel; exterior detail recovery is the criterion.

examples.prompt: The camera returns to the textile conservator at the workbench, showing her face as she looks down and resumes working.

evaluation_attributes_do_not_condition_o: Short wavy gray-blond hair and the same apparent face
review.observations: Local shows hands, sleeves, and a cleaning tool. Oracle is a frontal workbench view; GT is a close downward-facing profile and then pans down.
limitations: Gray sleeves are already in Local and do not count as recovered evidence.
GT face leaves the upper image near the end; whole-frame DINO mixes appearance, viewpoint and workbench content.
Embedded source captions are not removed; the selected image at 47.0 seconds has no bottom subtitle.
